note: Adventurers now occasionally set out to delve dungeons on their own. Watch one walk out of Mosslight toward the wilds and check back later: they may return with gold and loot, come back empty-handed, or limp home injured. Their hauls stay on them for now, with chest and bank storage coming next, and you can follow each run in the game log and the adventurer list. Player dungeons, loot, and entrances work exactly as before.
